steps.title: Create the OAuth app in Help Scout

steps.title: Use a placeholder redirect for internal apps

steps.detail: Authorize through the Help Scout Authorization screen with an active, invited user.

traps.title: Credentials need an active invited user

traps.title: No managed app to fall back on
